text.p: Eurotunnel Plc, the Anglo-French Channel Tunnel operator, said on Wednesday its Le Shuttle tourist vehicle traffic jumped to 241,273 in October from 120,368 in the year-ago month.
Le Shuttle also carried 60,360 freight trucks, up from 42,630 in October 1995, while Eurostar inter-city trains through the tunnel carried 498,244 passengers versus 327,347 a year ago.
Eurotunnel also said Railfreight's volume hit a new monthly record of 230,109 tonnes compared to 150,829 a year earlier.

The recent bank holiday weekend in France indicated a good start to November, with daily traffic levels for Le Shuttle Tourist equalling those achieved during July and August, the company said in a statement.
From Thursday to Sunday, 43,719 tourist vehicles (including 1,195 coaches) were carried, Eurotunnel said.
It added that it believed Le Shuttle's market share for cars on the Dover-Calais route was now approaching 50 percent.
